title: (Pwn2Own) Canon imageCLASS MF654Cdw PJCC Request Parsing Heap-based Buffer Overflow Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Canon imageCLASS MF654Cdw printers. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the CADM service, which listens on TCP port 9013 by default.
